# **Terms and Conditions**

Parties hereby agree that all purchases made are subject to the following terms and conditions as well as any terms and conditions stated on the invoices.

1. All sales will be C.O.D. until credit application is approved.
2. Credit terms are Net-30 days from the date of the invoice with interest to accrue at 24% per annum (2% per month) on any past-due balance or the maximum rate allowed by law. Invoices are not payable in installments, but are payable in full. All accounts over forty-five (45) days will be placed on a C.O.D. basis.
3. In the event a dispute arises in connection with this agreement, the prevailing party is entitled to reasonable collection and/or attorney's fees. If suit is brought, jurisdiction and venue may be laid in the province and city of ID Key Company's choice.
4. The undersigned agrees that invoices and monthly statements, which are sent upon request, are conclusive and accurate in all respects unless undersigned notifies ID Key Company in writing within ten (10) days of receipt of the invoice(s) or statement. The undersigned further agrees to notify ID Key Company in writing of any defects, overstock, damages, non-conforming goods, or any other reason(s) that would cause purchaser to reject goods shipped by ID Key Company within seven (7) business days of receipt of goods.
5. Seller may apply payments in its sole discretion unless purchaser clearly indicates how funds are to be applied.
